thesis: The site is a two-page Marietta almanac: SPRING and FALL halves share one kidney-shaped bed mask, and a season ribbon at the top turns from dogwood cream to oak rust as you scroll.

signature.name: two-page almanac
signature.summary: A season ribbon pinned at the header interpolates from dogwood cream to oak rust based on scroll position; each section carries data-season=spring|fall. The kidney-shaped bed outline from the hero returns as the frame for season photos, area map, and review portraits.

palette.family: loblolly green + red clay + dogwood cream

motion.intro: Dogwood petals drift across the kidney mask once as the photo unclips inside it (<=1.2s).
stories: Season ribbon turns cream-to-rust at page midpoint; bed-shape photo swaps spring-to-fall inside the same mask (pinned >=640px, stacked cards on phone).
Refresh clock updates output live with staggered reveal of result line.
motion.hover: Hairline underline grows scaleX(0->1) from left, 200ms, on links and card titles under @media (hover:hover).
